title: Chapter 1215
text:
Dozens of Beyond Grade A Supers were frozen in midair. The scene was spectacular, but Han Xiao and Kasuyi had no time to appreciate it. Both of them were focused on dealing with the Guardian.

The duration of the interference was limited. Now was the time for explosive power. Before the effect of the interference device ended, if they could not kill the Guardian quickly, Han Xiao would have no choice but to use the King to escape with the other two.

The more outsiders died in this secondary dimension, the more doppelgangers the Guardian would have. Now, it was the fourth batch, and the difficulty of the challenge had become extremely terrifying.

One main body and seven doppelgangers were not affected and could still move freely. Even though Kasuyi took the initiative to restrain the doppelgangers, he had limited energy and could not take care of all aspects. From time to time, the doppelgangers' attacks would pass through his defense and land on Han Xiao's Mechanical Deity.

In order to maintain his output, Han Xiao did not dodge the attacks at all and took all of them head-on. He did not defend at all, completely exchanging damage for damage. It was as if he had caught an unlucky guy in a group fight and beat him up. Relying on his tankiness, not only did these attacks not pose much of a threat to him, but they also increased the speed at which he stacked temporary attribute bonuses, increasing his output.

At this moment, he did not hold back at all and used all his explosive abilities. The Mechanical Deity and the Mech Legion had completely entered berserk mode.

All the Mechanic's overload abilities were activated, and the True Damage of (Legendary Battle Technique) was constantly triggered. There was also a divine skill (Painful Revenge) that was even more lethal. For every 3% of his Health Points lost, it could cause 1.5% of his Health Points in melee damage. All of these were stacked on the slash of the Celestial Punishment Edge.

This ability came from the Dark-star leader. Back then, he was still a Calamity Grade with less than a few hundred thousand HP. Now, he had become a Beyond Grade A monster with more than forty million HP. Even if each attack could only cause 1.5% damage, it was still an additional 600,000 damage.

Furthermore, in order to keep taking hits to recover his MP, Han Xiao had been controlling the weapons in the Mechanical Deity to fire at his main body. His HP dropped and rose repeatedly, allowing this skill to be triggered continuously. Even if this normal damage would be reduced by shields and resistances, it would not be able to cover the lethality of (Painful Revenge). The power of each attack was far beyond a normal Beyond Grade A killer move.

Coupled with the bonuses from the Machinery Faith, the ten stacks of God's Trait Transformation, [Fearless Heart], [Polar Channel Flow — Blood Rage], the bonuses from the many Gold grade mechanical equipment, and the explosive increase in attributes after the level 340 Promotion … Even Han Xiao himself did not know how terrifying his damage would be when he went all out.

Under the concentrated fire of the Mechanical Deity and the Mech Legion, the energy shield summoned by the Guardian's main body basically exploded as soon as it appeared, and its health dropped rapidly.

Although it was a dimensional consciousness body and had inexhaustible energy, its own strength limited its energy output. The speed at which it replenished its energy shield could not keep up with Han Xiao's destructive efficiency at all.

If it was a life form with normal thinking, it would naturally understand that it was no match for Han Xiao and would not fight to the death. It would definitely start to look for a way out. However, the Guardian's main body did not have any emotions and would only act according to the incomplete preset program. It could not go against the core mechanism, and it would not escape. It would only fight to the death.

The only advantage of the Guardian's main body was its flexibility. It was like a fish in water in its own home ground. Han Xiao's Void talent was temporarily frozen, so he could not use various flash methods. Instead, he could not keep up with the opponent's speed. Most of the Mech Legion's long-range attacks were dodged by the agile Guardian's main body.

"A lot of damage is wasted. It has certain characteristics of an energy body, and its health recovery speed is also very fast. If this drags on, my success rate of killing it before the interference device loses its effect is probably only about forty percent. That's a bit low … I haven't used [Gene Liberation] yet, and the cooldown is relatively long. I should only have time to use it once. I need to maximize my damage output …"

Han Xiao's actions of pouring firepower did not stop. His eyes moved slightly.

It seems like I can only use my traditional skills …

With that in mind, the Mechanical Deity suddenly disintegrated and turned back into the Mech Legion. Han Xiao's main body came out, opened his arms, and revealed his weak body to the fullest, tempting the rigid Guardian's main body.

Sure enough, the Guardian's main body did not say anything and directly charged over. In his preset tactical model, the tactic to target the weakness of a Mechanic was to attack the 'fragile' body of the Mechanic when the target exposed its main body.

Han Xiao did not dodge and faced it head-on, allowing the Guardian's main body to crash into his thick chest muscles and explode with a ring of energy shockwaves. He did not care about the health loss of this attack at all. His arms wrapped around the target tightly, not allowing the opponent to escape. He then grinned.

"Little thing, still running? Come into daddy's arms."

He had not used this move for a very long time. The main reason was that he was infamous in the explored universe, and everyone knew this move of his. Only a fool would fall for such a trap. Only when facing someone like this who did not know his background would his traditional skills have a second chance.

Without any hesitation, Han Xiao directly activated [Gene Liberation] and gave the Mech Legion an order.

"Eat my — God! Earth! Same! Life! "

Boom! Boom! Boom!

In an instant, endless psionic cannons drowned the two of them. The dazzling light instantly expanded and occupied everyone's vision.

"Mechanics can fight like this?"

Jayz, who was unable to move, only felt that his horizons had been broadened.

"Are all young people these days playing so big …" On the other side, the corner of Kasuyi's eyes twitched. The energy level feedback from his senses made his heart beat rapidly, and he felt a strong threat to his life.

The dozens of officers of the Superpower Security Department present were even more dumbfounded.

From the beginning, they had been wondering what kind of enmity these two people had for them to fight so fiercely.

Weren't these two wanted criminals here to attack our headquarters? Why didn't they attack us while we were immobilized? Instead, they focused on dealing with a group of mysterious Supers that appeared out of thin air … Why did we, the main characters, become spectators instead?

Just as this thought flashed through everyone's mind, the light ball of the energy chain reaction suddenly exploded, bursting out with a terrifying energy shockwave.

Boom!

The surrounding mechanical troops and other people were all blown away, instantly clearing a large empty area.

When the light dissipated, Han Xiao was seen floating alone at the center of the explosion, covered in blood, and in front of him was a shattered body.

Han Xiao was expressionless and looked very calm, but in fact, he almost broke out in cold sweat, and his emotions could not calm down.

'F * ck, that was close. I didn't know that my attack power had reached such a level. I almost sent myself away …'

Just now, his luck had exploded to the maximum damage increase range of [Gene Liberation] with a 20% chance. The lethality of the Mech Legion's explosion had also shocked him, and the large fluctuation of his HP made his heart skip a beat.

The scale of the army I can control now is very large, and the attack power is completely different from before. I have to be careful when using this move in the future. Otherwise, it will really end in mutual destruction one day …

Han Xiao patted his chest and secretly heaved a sigh of relief.

Even he was in such a dangerous situation, and the Guardian's main body was even more tragic, dying on the spot. From the battle to its death, it did not even leave behind any last words … although it would not say anything.

"You killed it just like that?"

Kasuyi's eyes widened.

He had thought that he would have to go through a tough battle, but he did not expect Black Star's lethality to be so terrifying. He had eliminated the target in just a few moves, and the efficiency was frightening.

Although he did not say it explicitly, his tone undoubtedly revealed his thoughts. It was done so easily?

Hearing Kasuyi's words, Han Xiao knew what he was thinking and said in annoyance,

"You think it's easy because I'm strong! If it were you, we would definitely have to run away today. "

Even an ordinary peak Beyond Grade A would have a slim chance of survival in such a situation. Only an anomaly like him could easily complete this round of the mission.

The communication between the two of them in the mental channel only lasted for a split second. At this moment, the chain reaction of the destruction of the dimensional consciousness body appeared.

The remains of the Guardian's main body automatically disintegrated into dust-like particles and dissipated in an instant. With it as the center, the same signs appeared in the surrounding space. The affected area continued to spread in all directions, as if a singularity had collapsed. The entire dimension began to collapse in a chain, and the visual effect was as if a certain director of the Universe Family Planning Office had snapped his fingers.

The spacetime loop phantom of this mutated Information Form was like a precision instrument that barely maintained its balance, and the dimensional consciousness body was the core component. At this moment, there was a problem with the core, and the entire instrument stopped operating. The balance was broken, and it began to report faults, causing a chain of disintegration.

Only Han Xiao and Kasuyi, the two outsiders, and the things they brought in from the outside, were not affected. The other substances that belonged to this spacetime loop were disintegrating. The first to bear the brunt was the mechanical army and the other seven Guardian avatars that were created in the past few months. They were annihilated and evaporated in front of everyone's eyes.

The foundation of the spacetime loop was disrupted, and the effect of the interference device also failed. When the many members of the Superpower Security Department saw this scene, they were all shocked and wanted to continue to encircle the two of them.

However, the body of the nearest Director-General also began to disintegrate automatically. Under everyone's horrified gaze, this person turned into ashes in the blink of an eye. His Supreme combat strength was of no use at all.

"What's going on? What have you done? "

"Run! You'll die! "

Everyone present was extremely shocked. They did not care about catching the two of them and turned to run, only wanting to get as far away from the expanding disintegration area as possible.

However, Jayz stayed where he was and smiled at Han Xiao.

Han Xiao noticed the vibration of the communicator and took it out to take a look. The rest of the technical information was sent over by Jayz. The other party had fulfilled the deal.

There was also a message left by Jayz.

"Black Star, our World Reboot Plan has not completely failed. At least we have left our legacy to the future.

I know that you have a certain level of vigilance against me, and I admit that I do have extra selfishness. Now that things have come to this, there is no need to hide it from you. I will teach you all my knowledge. It's both a deal and an experiment …

"Do you remember the mechanism of the Sanctum that I told you about? Resurrecting a Beyond Grade A requires a medium with target information … and you, who have inherited the knowledge, may be able to become my medium.

"If one day, you successfully communicate with the resurrection function of the Sanctum, please try to resurrect me and see if you can cross the Iterations. Whether you succeed or fail, it will be a valuable piece of information for you.

"However, even if the resurrection is successful, I will not retain the memories in the loop. It will be a brand new me. This should be the last time we meet. Although the time we spent together was short, I am very happy to meet you … the successor of the Iteration."

After reading the message, Han Xiao looked up and saw Jayz with a relieved smile on his face. His body gradually turned into ashes and disappeared without a trace.

Looking at this scene, Han Xiao silently chewed on this word.

"Successor, huh …"
